replayr: parsers for emulator movie ("input log") files

Source: R/replayr-package.R
replayr-package.Rd

Decoders for 11 emulator movie file formats used by the speedrun and tool-assisted-speedrun communities. Every parser produces a uniform in-memory shape (a replayr_movie S3 object) with a per-frame logical input matrix indexed against a single 30-slot universal-button layout.

Details

Supported formats: .fm2 (FCEUX), .bk2 (BizHawk), .fcm (FCEU), .lsmv (lsnes), .gmv (Gens-rerecording), .vbm (VBA-rerecording), .m64 (Mupen64), .smv (Snes9x-rerecording), .pxm (PSXjin binary), .pjm (PSXjin text), .dtm (Dolphin GameCube).

Quick start


  library(replayr)
  mv <- read_movie("data/raw_nes/super_mario_bros/1349.fm2")
  n_frames(mv)                       # frame count
  press_counts(mv)                   # per-button press counts
  p1 <- player(mv, 1L)               # logical matrix, frames x buttons

Universal button layout

Each replayr_movie indexes its third dimension against a prefix of the 30-slot universal layout. Slots 1..8 are NES-shaped (R, L, D, U, Start, Select, B, A); higher slots cover SNES, Genesis, GBA, N64, PSX, GameCube. See universal_buttons() and universal_button_names().
